text.section: If a partner's dissociation results in a dissolution and winding up of the partnership business, Article 8 applies; otherwise, Article 7 applies.

Upon a partner's dissociation:
The partner's right to participate in the management and conduct of the partnership business terminates, except as otherwise provided in § 50-73.119;
The partner's duty of loyalty under subdivision B 3 of § 50-73.102 terminates; and
The partner's duty of loyalty under subdivisions B 1 and B 2 of § 50-73.102 and duty of care under subsection C of § 50-73.102 continue only with regard to matters arising and events occurring before the partner's dissociation, unless the partner participates in winding up the partnership's business pursuant to § 50-73.119.
